task: Write the conclusion section for incident INC-2026-0731 covering workstation WS-42.

evidence.observation: EDR telemetry for host WS-42 is complete for 2026-07-31T00:00:00Z through 2026-08-07T00:00:00Z.
No process execution on WS-42 matched the deployed detection ruleset during that window.
Netflow retention for VLAN 30 lapsed on 2026-08-02, so egress activity after that date was not captured.
The reported phishing message was quarantined by the mail gateway before delivery to the WS-42 mailbox.
